name: Ai Zai Chuji zhi Chu
source:
"Love Where Touches" is a story-rich Visual Novel centered on psychology, the mechanics of magic, and forgotten memories.

High school student Tsusaka(Tsukasa) Murasaki leads a life of strict, almost obsessive routine. Yet, a subtle sense of discord constantly lingers beneath his ordinary days—the unexplainable habit of cooking "three servings" of dinner and bento every day, the lingering "scars of memory" in his dreams, and Mihri, a mysterious girl with knee-length hair sitting in the corner of his classroom, completely ignored by everyone else...

"Magic stems from repressed human emotions. When one longs deeply to be 'ignored' or 'saved,' reality redraws its own rules for you."

As the uncanny urban legend of "Santa" begins to spread across the school, the cruel truths and magical laws hidden behind mundane life gradually surface. Step into the shoes of the protagonist to unravel the profound and moving destiny that binds you, the mysterious Midori, your fierce childhood friend Chiami, and your adoptive mother Mariya.
